content: SFSpeechRecognizer on-device mode: set SFSpeechAudioBufferRecognitionRequest.requiresOnDeviceRecognition=true (audio stays on device) after checking SFSpeechRecognizer.supportsOnDeviceRecognition; requires NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription + NSMicrophoneUsageDescription Info.plist keys (app crashes without them) and requestAuthorization before use. Feed mic audio via AVAudioEngine input taps into the buffer request; results delivered through recognitionTask delegate/handler on hypothesized+final transcriptions.
